title: Cultural Compass: Predicting Transfer Learning Success in Offensive Language Detection with Cultural Features

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring performance disparities in zero-shot cross-cultural transfer learning for Offensive Language Detection (OLD), and using Hofstede's Cultural Dimensions (such as Power Distance and Individualism) to predict transfer success between source and target countries.

Evaluating cross-lingual transfer learning effectiveness by comparing target model performance against language-dependent features, including linguistic typological distances (syntactic, phonological) and the semantic distance of offensive words across languages.
